purpose: Trigger an action. Not for navigation unless `render` supplies a link element.

supplied: native <button> semantics, including Enter and Space activation
disabled state via the native attribute
the spinner is aria-hidden; loadingText is announced
required: aria-label when the button is icon-only (`icon` with no children)
type="submit" on the button that submits a form; the default is "button"

composition.notes: Nesting interactive elements is invalid HTML and traps keyboard focus. Use `render` to change the element instead of wrapping it.

safeMutations.rationale: Appearance is safe for an agent to change. `type` and `onClick` change behaviour; `loading` and `disabled` are owned by the component's own async handling.

propNotes.render: Escape hatch for router links. Changes the rendered element, so composition rules apply to whatever it returns.
propNotes.loading: Managed automatically when `onClick` returns a promise. Setting it manually opts out of that.
